title: Jack-Tar Model Catalog
description: Single source of truth for AI model identities, capabilities, and pricing across all jack-tar plugins (EPIC #125). Model IDs, aliases, retirement pointers, resolution capability, and cost tables live HERE, not in code. The loader (model_catalog.py) merges: shipped baseline -> cached remote (~/.jack-tar/model-catalog.json) -> local-config.json overrides.

catalog_version.description: Semver of the catalog DATA (independent of plugin versions). Bump patch for price/name corrections, minor for new models, major for schema-shape changes.

min_loader_version.description: Minimum model_catalog.py LOADER_VERSION able to consume this catalog. A remote catalog with min_loader_version > installed loader is rejected at refresh time.

updated.description: Date this catalog content was last verified/edited (YYYY-MM-DD).

role_defaults.description: Default model id per role. Value is a model id string, or an ordered preference list of model ids (first available wins — used for local_draft where installation varies per machine).

id.description: Canonical model identifier as the provider's API accepts it TODAY (e.g. 'gemini-3.1-flash-image', 'fal-ai/flux-2-pro', 'x/flux2-klein'). Ollama entries are tag-prefixes; exact installed tags resolve at runtime via /api/tags.

provider.description: Provider family: google | openai | fal | recraft | ollama | mlx | ...

aliases.description: Former or alternate names that resolve to this entry (e.g. retired '-preview' suffixed ids, router-side short names). Must be globally unique across all ids and aliases.

status.description: active: use freely. deprecated: works but scheduled for retirement — loader warns. retired: provider no longer serves it — loader substitutes 'replacement'.

replacement.description: Model id to substitute when this entry is retired/deprecated. REQUIRED (non-null) when status is 'retired'.

roles.description: What this model is FOR. Known roles: image_gen (raster generation), vlm (vision-language), vlm_json (VLM safe for strict-JSON parsers — thinking models are NOT), icon (vector icon generation), upscale, local_draft (free local draft tier).

quirks.description: Behavioural gotchas encoded as data. Known quirks: thinking (emits reasoning tokens that break strict JSON parsers), fixed_resolution (rejects image_size/sampleImageSize param — issue #74), no_negative_prompt, upscale_chain_4k (4K = 2K generation + creative upscale chain).

text_rendering.description: In-image text rendering quality — drives router preference for text-bearing slides.

brand_hex_fidelity.description: Renders exact specified hex colours (Recraft) vs approximating them.

prompt_budget.description: Prompt-translator budget: word cap + translation style key.

verified.description: Date this pricing was last checked against provider docs/billing.

estimate.description: true when the numbers are inferred/assumed rather than provider-published (e.g. Recraft direct-API upscale FAL-parity assumption).

flat.description: Flat USD per image regardless of parameters.

per_resolution.description: USD per image keyed by resolution tier ('512'|'1K'|'2K'|'4K').

backends.description: Backend-dependent per-resolution pricing (Google Imagen: 'vertex' flat vs 'developer' token-based). Keys are backend names, values are per-resolution maps.

per_tier.description: USD per image keyed by provider tier name (icon generation: 'standard'|'pro').

token_rates.description: Per-MTok token rates for actual-cost computation from API usage metadata (e.g. text_input_per_mtok, image_output_per_mtok). Component names follow the provider's usage surface.

tiered_megapixel.description: USD for first megapixel + per additional megapixel (FAL FLUX 2 Pro).

env_override.description: Env vars that override specific price components at call time, keyed by component (e.g. {"upscale": "RECRAFT_UPSCALE_COST_USD"}).

api.description: Which API surface serves this model: generate_content (Nano Banana), generate_images (Imagen), openai_images, fal_subscribe, recraft_rest, ollama_generate, ...

config_field.description: SDK config field carrying the resolution (google-genai ImageConfig: 'image_size' — verified present on SDK 2.11.0, issue #121).

endpoint.description: Endpoint path/id where it differs from the model id.
